confirmed_findings.claim: The ACDSL self-management gate in gated/strict mode can be trivially bypassed because CheckPolicy resolves the authoritative base commit from the agent-editable working-copy acdsl/policy.json base_ref, so pointing base_ref at a pre-policy commit makes basePolicy fall back to the working policy and mode "free" short-circuits before surfaceDelta runs.
confirmed_findings.fix: Resolve the base commit only from fixed, non-agent-controlled candidates (origin/HEAD, origin/main, main, master); if base_ref remains an override it must come from outside the working tree (e.g. a harness-supplied environment variable) or the resolved base must be validated as an ancestor of a fixed candidate ref, and basePolicy's no-policy-at-base fallback to the working copy must never apply when base_ref came from the working copy.

confirmed_findings.claim: The shipped acdsl/policy.json sets mode "gated" with no dist_mode field, contradicting the approved plan's D11/D8 decision (mode "free" for smine plus dist_mode "gated" for targets) and risking gated mode flagging smine's own sanctioned generation-flow commits.
confirmed_findings.fix: Confirm whether this was a deliberate late decision (and if so update the plan's Changelog and D11/D8) or a rollout gap to be corrected back to the free/dist_mode split.

confirmed_findings.claim: The "Apply overrides" direction of handleConfigSyncOp copies the live settings file's raw bytes into the repo-tracked fragment without re-templating, baking a literal machine-specific port over the {{PEEK_CONTROL_PORT}} marker and breaking multi-profile port isolation for later syncs.
confirmed_findings.fix: Either re-collapse the live port back to the marker before writing into the fragment (the inverse of ExpandInstallMarkers), or block/warn when "Apply overrides" would write a marker-bearing section.

confirmed_findings.claim: The Bash-read detection only recognizes an unquoted two-token cat invocation, so a quoted command like cat "docs/rules/go.md" bypasses the don't-re-read-injected-context nudge.
confirmed_findings.fix: Tighten the pattern match (e.g. case "$command" in "cat "*) after stripping matched quotes) so the common quoted case is caught.

confirmed_findings.claim: The session-context-report plan is present but none of its files (sessionreport.go, session_report.html, contextRecord) exist at either endpoint of the diff, so it may be a dropped deliverable rather than deliberately out of scope.
confirmed_findings.fix: Confirm the plan is deliberately out of scope for 1.2.1 rather than a dropped deliverable.
